name: openbb_treasury_rates
description:
Meant to give the daily effective federal funds rate through OpenBB (obb.fixedincome.rate.dff).
Returns: {data_points, start_date, end_date, rates} or {error}.
Inputs (* required): start_date (YYYY-MM-DD; default one year ago); end_date (default today); provider (default federal_reserve).
OpenBB 4.x (4.6 checked) has no obb.fixedincome.rate.dff, so this tool currently returns an error object; alternatives: openbb_fixedincome_effr (provider federal_reserve), fred_fed_funds_rate or av_fed_funds_rate; Treasury yields: av_treasury_yield, fred_10yr_treasury.
Example: {"start_date": "2026-01-01"}
